Rashi on Ketubot 19b:10:1.english: And we collect with it - [This is] a rhetorical question.

Rashi on Ketubot 19b:10:2.hebrew: תרי ותרי נינהו - עדי השטר ב', ואלו ב' מעידים עליהם שפסולים היו באותה שעה:
Rashi on Ketubot 19b:10:2.english: They are two and two - The witnesses of the document [are] two, and these [are] two testifying about them that they were disqualified at that time.

Rashi on Ketubot 19b:1:1.english: And Rav Sheshet said - We read [this in the text].

Rashi on Ketubot 19b:1:2.hebrew: אעולה לא חתמי - וכי אמרי חתמנו, אין נאמנים להרשיע את עצמן:
Rashi on Ketubot 19b:1:2.english: They do not sign on injustice - And when they say, "We signed [it]," they are not deemed credible to incriminate themselves.

Rashi on Ketubot 19b:3:1.hebrew: על פשיטי דספרא - שעל הלוה ליתן שכר הסופר, ופעמים שאין לו ונותנו המלוה, וחוזר וגובהו ממנו בשעת פרעון, ומעכב השטר עליו:
Rashi on Ketubot 19b:3:1.english: For the coins of the scribe - For it is upon the borrower to give the scribe's fee, and at times he does not have [it] and the lender gives it, and [the lender] subsequently collects it from him at the time of repayment, and withholds the document against him.

Rashi on Ketubot 19b:4:1.hebrew: ספר שאינו מוגה - תורה, נביאים וכתובים:
Rashi on Ketubot 19b:4:1.english: A scroll that is not proofread - Torah, Prophets, and Writings.

Rashi on Ketubot 19b:5:1.hebrew: עדים - החתומים בשטר, ואמרו: "אמנה היו דברינו" — לא הלוהו כלום, אלא כתבנו לו לכשיצטרך ילוה לו, וזה שיעבד לו נכסיו מעכשיו אם ילוה אפילו לאחר זמן, דלאו מוקדם ליהוי לטרוף שלא כדין:
Rashi on Ketubot 19b:5:1.english: Witnesses - who are signed on a document, and said, "Our words were [a matter of] trust" — [meaning,] he did not lend him anything, rather we wrote [it] for him [so that] when he needs [money], he will borrow from him, and this [borrower] mortgaged his property to him from now [so that] if he borrows even after [some] time, it will not be [a] predated [document] to seize [property] unlawfully.

Rashi on Ketubot 19b:5:2.hebrew: מודעא היו דברינו - אם שטר מכר הוא, ואמרו עדים החתומים בו: המוכר מסר מודעא בפנינו, והראנו אונסו, והכרנו בו:
Rashi on Ketubot 19b:5:2.english: Our statement was a declaration - If it is a bill of sale, and the witnesses signed on it said, "The seller delivered a declaration [of duress] before us, and showed us his duress, and we recognized it."

Rashi on Ketubot 19b:5:3.english: They are not deemed credible - For [one] does not come orally and impair the document.

Rashi on Ketubot 19b:5:4.hebrew: מודעא, ניתן לעדים לכתוב את השטר כדי להציל האנוס מאונסו. אמנה, לא ניתן להכתב דעולה הואי, וכי אמרו חתמנו, משוי לנפשייהו רשעים, ואין אדם נאמן לשום עצמו רשע:
Rashi on Ketubot 19b:5:4.english: [Regarding] a declaration [of coercion], it is permitted for witnesses to write the document in order to save the coerced person from his coercion. [Regarding a document of] trust, it is not permitted to be written, because it is an injustice; and when they say, "We signed [such a document]," they render themselves wicked, and a person is not believed to render himself wicked.

Rashi on Ketubot 19b:6:1.hebrew: תנאי היו דברינו - על תנאי מכרה לו, שיעשה לו כך וכך, ולא ראינו שקיים לו תנאו, וזה אומר: לא קיים לי, ואינו מכר:
Rashi on Ketubot 19b:6:1.english: Our statement was a conditional [statement] - [The witnesses say:] He sold it to him on a condition that he would do such and such for him, and we did not see that he fulfilled his condition for him; and this [seller] says: He did not fulfill [it] for me, and it is not a [valid] sale.

Rashi on Ketubot 19b:6:2.english: A declaration and [a document of] trust - What is the reason [that] Master says they are not believed?

Rashi on Ketubot 19b:6:3.hebrew: דקא עקרי ליה לשטרא - בעדותן זה, ולא אתי על פה ומרע לשטרא. הכא נמי כו':
Rashi on Ketubot 19b:6:3.english: That they undermine the document - With this testimony of theirs; and an oral [statement] cannot come and impair a document. Here too, etc.

Rashi on Ketubot 19b:6:4.hebrew: או דלמא - הא לא עקרתא דשטרא הוא, דמודים הם שהשטר אמת, אלא שתנאי היה ביניהם, וזו עדות אחרת היא. ושטרא ממילא מיעקר לאחר זמן, ביום שלא קיים תנאו בזמנו:
Rashi on Ketubot 19b:6:4.english: Or perhaps - this is not an uprooting of the document, for they admit that the document is true, except that there was a condition between them, and this is a different testimony. And the document is uprooted on its own later on, on the day that he did not fulfill his condition in its time.

Rashi on Ketubot 19b:6:5.english: When they come before us - Buyers whose witnesses testify that their words were conditional.

Rashi on Ketubot 19b:6:6.hebrew: אמרי' להו זילו קיימו תנאייכו - לבעלים:
Rashi on Ketubot 19b:6:6.english: We say to them: Go fulfill your conditions - [This is said] to the parties [to the transaction].

Rashi on Ketubot 19b:6:7.english: And descend for judgment - If he still withholds the land.

Rashi on Ketubot 19b:7:1.hebrew: תרוייהו בשטרא מעליא קא מסהדי - שניהם מעידים שהשטר אמת, וכמות שהוא כתוב בלא תנאי חתמוהו:
Rashi on Ketubot 19b:7:1.english: Both of them testify to a valid document - Both of them testify that the document is authentic, and as it is written — without a condition — they signed it.

Rashi on Ketubot 19b:7:2.english: And this [witness] who says, "[There was a] condition," is one - and he is not believed to uproot a document on which both of them are signed.

Rashi on Ketubot 19b:8:1.hebrew: אי הכי אפילו תרוייהו נמי אלא אמרינן כו' - אי הכי, דכיון שהעיד על כתב ידו, עשית לזה אחד ממקיימי השטר כמות שהוא כתוב בלא תנאי, והוי להו עדיו שנים, ועדות אחרונה דברי אחד במקום שנים:
Rashi on Ketubot 19b:8:1.english: If [it is] so, even both [of them] as well; rather, we say, etc. - If [it is] so — that once he testified regarding his signature, you have made this [witness] one of those who validate the document as it is written, without a condition, and its witnesses are two, and the latter testimony is the words of one [witness] in place of two.

Rashi on Ketubot 19b:8:2.hebrew: אפי' תרוייהו נמי - אמרי "תנאי היו דברינו", לא ליתהימנו, דכיון שהעידו על כתב ידן, קיימו השטר כמות שהוא כתוב, וכי אמרי "תנאי היו דברינו", הוו להו מגידים וחוזרים ומגידים; ואמאי אמר רב נחמן "קיימו תנאייכו" כו':
Rashi on Ketubot 19b:8:2.english: Even both of them too - [if] they say, "Our words were conditional," they should not be believed, since once they testified regarding their handwriting, they upheld the document as it is written; and when they say, "Our words were conditional," they are [like witnesses who] testify and then testify again. And why [then] did Rav Nachman say, "Fulfill your condition," etc.?

Rashi on Ketubot 19b:8:3.hebrew: אלא - על כרחך, לאו חתימה מקויימת הוא, דכיון דתוך כדי דבור מסקי דבורייהו ואמרי "אבל תנאי היה ביניהן", אמרינן: הני למיעקר סהדותייהו — שאמרו "כתב ידינו הוא" — קאתו, ולומר "לא חתמנו אלא ע"מ שיקיים את התנאי". וכיון דתנאי מלתא אחריתי היא, שאינה עוקרתו אלא לאחר זמן, לא דמיא למודעא ואמנה, ומהימני, דעדות בפני עצמה היא:
Rashi on Ketubot 19b:8:3.english: Rather - Perforce, it is not a validated signature, for since within the span of an utterance they conclude their statement and say, "However, there was a condition between them," we say [that] these [witnesses] are coming to uproot their testimony — [when] they said, "It is our handwriting" — and to say, "We only signed on condition that he fulfills the condition." And since a condition is a different matter, which only uproots [the document] after [some] time, it is not similar to a protest (moda'ah) or [a document of] trust (amanah), and they are believed, for it is an independent testimony.

Rashi on Ketubot 19b:8:4.hebrew: האי נמי - כי סיים ואמר תנאי הוה, עקר לחתימת ידיה לומר לא חתמתי אלא על מנת כן. וכיון דאית לן דמלתא אחריתי היא ושטרא ממילא מיעקר, אישתכח דאין בשטר חתום אלא ע"א:
Rashi on Ketubot 19b:8:4.english: This [one] as well - When he concludes and says, "There was a condition," he uproots his signature, saying, "I only signed on this condition." And since we hold that [the condition] is a separate matter and the document is automatically uprooted, it turns out that there is only one witness signed on the document.

Rashi on Ketubot 19b:9:1.english: That one raised a challenge against it - That the defendant wanted to disqualify it.

Tosafot on Ketubot 19b:11:1.hebrew: אמר רב ששת זאת אומרת הכחשה תחלת הזמה היא - וא"ת, תקשי לרב ששת ברייתא דמי שמת (ג"ז שם), דקתני: "אם אמר שטר אמנה הוא, אם יש עדים" — פירוש: דשטר אמנה הוא — "הלך אחר עדים, ואם לאו הלך אחר השטר". אלמא אע"ג דאין השטר צריך קיום — כדאמר "הלך אחר השטר", שמודה הלוה שכתבו, כדאיתא התם — [ואפילו הכי] אם יש עדים הלך אחר עדים, ולא אמרינן "הכחשה תחלת הזמה"? וי"ל ד"זאת אומרת" קאמר, אבל ההיא פליג:
Tosafot on Ketubot 19b:11:1.english: Rav Sheshet said: That is to say, contradiction is the beginning of rendering [witnesses] conspiring - And if you ask: Let the baraita of [the chapter] Mi Shemet (also there) pose a difficulty for Rav Sheshet, as it teaches: "If one said, 'It is a document of trust,' if there are witnesses" — meaning, [witnesses] that it is a document of trust — "follow the witnesses; and if not, follow the document." Thus, even though the document does not require authentication — as it says, "follow the document," because the borrower admits that he wrote it, as is [stated] there — [nevertheless,] if there are witnesses, follow the witnesses, and we do not say "contradiction is the beginning of rendering [them] conspiring"? And one can answer that [Rav Sheshet] is saying "That is to say" [i.e., inferring this from our Mishnah], whereas that [baraita] disagrees.

Tosafot on Ketubot 19b:1:1.hebrew: אעולה לא חתמי - והא דכותבין שטר ללוה אע"פ שאין מלוה עמו, היינו למוסרו ללוה ולא למלוה:
Tosafot on Ketubot 19b:1:1.english: They do not sign [a document of] injustice - And [as for] that which they write a document for a borrower even though [the] lender is not with him, that is [only] to hand it over to the borrower and not to the lender.

Tosafot on Ketubot 19b:2:1.hebrew: אם און בידך הרחיקהו זה שטר פסים ושטר אמנה - דהכי משמע לשון "און", דמעיקרא הוי שקר; ו"אל תשכן באהליך עולה זה שטר פרוע" — שעתה הוא עולה, אבל מעיקרא הוה אמת:
Tosafot on Ketubot 19b:2:1.english: "If iniquity be in your hand, put it far away" — this [is] a document of security [passim] and a document of trust - For this is what the term "iniquity" [aven] implies: that from the outset it was falsehood. And "[And] let not injustice dwell in your tents" — this [is] a repaid document: [meaning] that now it is injustice, whereas from the outset it was true.

Tosafot on Ketubot 19b:3:1.hebrew: זמנין דמשהי ליה אפשיטי דספרא - וע"י אותה שהייה אישתלי ליה שהותא פעם אחרת, הלכך לא קרי ליה עולה. ומ"ד שטר פרוע — היה לו ליזהר. אבל אין לפרש דמשום שהייתו אפשיטי דספרא קרי ליה עולה, דמה פשע:
Tosafot on Ketubot 19b:3:1.english: "At times he keeps it for the scribe's coins" - And through that retention, he inadvertently retains [a repaid document] another time; therefore, it is not called "injustice." And the one who says [that the verse refers to] a repaid document [holds that] he should have been careful. However, one cannot explain that it is because of his retaining it for the scribe's coins that [the verse] calls it "injustice," for what wrong did he commit?

Tosafot on Ketubot 19b:5:1.hebrew: אמר רב נחמן עדים שאמרו אמנה היו דברינו אין נאמנים - ע"כ באין כתב ידן יוצא ממקום אחר איירי, דאי כתב ידן יוצא ממקום אחר — פשיטא, דהכי פריך לעיל; ועוד, דמר בר רב אשי קאמר דאין נאמנים משום דלא ניתן לכתב, ואי בכתב ידן יוצא ממקום אחר, אפילו ניתן לכתב פשיטא דאין נאמנים. וקשה: דאמאי לא מהימני במיגו? דהא רב נחמן גופיה אית ליה לעיל מגו לפסול השטר, דקאמר: "כי אתו לקמן לדינא אמרינן להו: זילו קיימו שטרייכו וחותו לדינא", דמהימן לומר "פרוע" במגו ד"מזויף", וכ"ש עדים דאלימי לאורועי שטרא, כדאמר במי שמת (ב"ב דף קנד.)! ותירץ ר"י: דהיינו טעמא דמודעא — הואיל ומודים שהשטר נכתב ונמסר כהלכתו, שוב לא אתי על פה ומרע לשטרא אפילו במגו. ולא דמי לאנוסים וקטנים דמתניתין, שאין מודים שהיה שטר כשר כלל אלא סותרין אותו, הלכך מהימני במגו, דלא שייך כאן לומר דלא אתי על פה ומרע לשטרא, שהרי אינם מודים שהיה שטר. ואמנה נמי, נראה דהיינו טעמא דלא מהימני לרב נחמן — דלא מרעי לשטרא הואיל ומודים שהשטר נכתב כדין מדעת הלוה, דלא מפרש טעמא דאמנה משום דלא ניתן לכתב אלא מר בר רב אשי, אבל לרב נחמן טעם אמנה ומודעא שניהם שוה. והא דאית ליה לרב נחמן דנאמן לומר "פרוע" הוא במגו ד"מזויף" — התם נמי לא מרע לשטרא כלל, הלכך מהימן במגו, ואתי שפיר רב נחמן כרבנן דר"מ; וההיא ברייתא דמי שמת (ג"ז שם:) ד"שטר אמנה הוא זה" דאינו נאמן, דבעי לאוקמי כר"מ — רב נחמן מוקי לה לדברי הכל:
Tosafot on Ketubot 19b:5:1.english: Rav Nachman said: Witnesses who say, "Our statement was [a statement of] trust," are not deemed credible - Perforce, [the Gemara] is speaking of [a case] where their handwriting does not emerge from another source, for if their handwriting emerges from another source — it is obvious [that they are not credible], as [the Gemara] asks thus above; and furthermore, Mar bar Rav Ashi says that they are not believed because it may not be written, whereas if their handwriting emerges from another source, even if it may be written, it is obvious that they are not believed. And it is difficult: Why are they not believed by means of a migo? For Rav Nachman himself holds above [that we apply] a migo to invalidate a document, as he says: "When they come before us for judgment, we say to them: Go validate your documents and come down to judgment," for [the borrower] is believed to say "[It is] paid" with a migo of "[It is] forged" — and all the more so witnesses, who have the power to undermine a document, as [the Gemara] says in [chapter] Mi SheMeit (Bava Batra 154a)! And the Ri answered: This is the reason for [the case of] a declaration [of coercion] — since they admit that the document was written and handed over according to its law, an oral [statement] cannot then come and undermine a [written] document, even with a migo. And it is not similar to [the cases of] "coerced" and "minors" of our Mishnah, where they do not admit that there was a valid document at all, rather they contradict it; therefore they are believed with a migo, because it is not applicable here to say that an oral [statement] cannot come and undermine a document, since they do not admit that there was a [valid] document. And [regarding] a document of trust as well, it appears that this is the reason they are not believed according to Rav Nachman — that they cannot undermine the document since they admit that the document was written properly with the borrower's consent; for only Mar bar Rav Ashi explains the reason for [a document of] trust as being because it may not be written, whereas according to Rav Nachman, the reason for [a document of] trust and [a document with] a declaration are both the same. And [as for] that which Rav Nachman holds that [the borrower] is believed to say "[It is] paid" with a migo of "[It is] forged" — there too he does not undermine the document at all; therefore he is believed with a migo, and Rav Nachman aligns well with the Rabbis who dispute R. Meir; and that baraita in [chapter] Mi SheMeit (also there, 154b) regarding "This is a document of trust," that he is not believed, which [the Gemara there] sought to establish according to R. Meir — Rav Nachman establishes it according to all opinions:

Tosafot on Ketubot 19b:6:1.hebrew: או דלמא תנאי מילתא אחריתי היא - פי': לדבר אחר הן באין, ולא לעקירת השטר, אלא תוספת בעלמא, שמפרשים עדותן היאך, ועד השתא קיים השטר, ואינו נעקר אם יתקיים התנאי; הלכך אין כאן הורעת השטר. אבל אין לפרש "מילתא אחריתי היא" לגמרי ולא שייך לעדותן ראשונה, כמו שאם היו מעידין שהוא פרוע שהן נאמנים; דא"כ, מאי פריך בסמוך: "א"ה אפי' תרי נמי"? דכיון דתנאי מילתא אחריתי הוא לגמרי, תרי נאמנים אפילו בכתב ידן יוצא ממקום אחר, אבל חד — לעולם אימא לך דלא מהימן, כי היכי דלא מהימן לומר "פרוע הוא". לכך נראה כדפירשנו:
Tosafot on Ketubot 19b:6:1.english: Or perhaps a condition is a different matter - Explanation: They are coming [to testify about] another matter, and not to uproot the document, but [it is] merely an addition, as they are explaining how their testimony [applies]; and up until now the document remains valid, and it is not uprooted if the condition is fulfilled; therefore, there is no impairment of the document here. However, one should not explain [that] "it is a different matter" completely and [that] it is unrelated to their first testimony, just as if they were testifying that [the debt] is paid, where they are believed; for if so, what does [the Gemara] challenge shortly below: "If so, even two [witnesses] as well"? For since a condition is a completely different matter, two [witnesses] are believed even when their handwriting emerges from another place, whereas one [witness] — I could still say to you that he is not believed, just as he is not believed to say "it is paid." Therefore, it appears [correct] as we have explained.

Tosafot on Ketubot 19b:9:1.hebrew: ואם כתב ידן יוצא ממקום אחר אין נאמנים - ופסולי עדות דקתני — לא שאומרים שעדיין פסולים, דאם כן אמאי אין נאמנים? אלא פסולי עדות הוו אז, ועתה מודים שהם כשרים. וא"ת: ומכל מקום אמאי אין נאמנים? להימנו במגו דאי בעו אומרים עדיין הם פסולים! [וכן בכל] שתי כתי עדים המכחישות זו את זו, אמאי לא מהימני בתראי במגו דאי בעו פסלי לקמאי בגזלנותא? ואור"י דבשני עדים לא שייך מגו, דאין אחד יודע מה בלב חבירו:
Tosafot on Ketubot 19b:9:1.english: And if their handwriting emerges from another place, they are not deemed credible - And [regarding] "disqualified witnesses" that [the baraita] teaches: [this] does not [mean] that they say they are still disqualified, for if so, why are they not deemed credible? Rather, [they say that] they were disqualified witnesses then, and now they admit that they are valid [witnesses]. And if you will say: Even so, why are they not deemed credible? Let them be believed with a migo [as they could have made a stronger claim], since if they wanted, they could say [that] they are still disqualified! [And similarly, in all] cases of two sets of witnesses that contradict each other, why are the latter [witnesses] not believed with a migo, since if they wanted, they could disqualify the first [set] by [accusing them of] robbery? And Rabbeinu Yitzchak says that with two witnesses, migo does not apply, because one does not know what is in his fellow's heart.
